label: D2 rare transition a2 -> S1
explanation: Reset-gate unit 20 fires only at D2 (never D1/GO), only when the shown state is S1 (100% of mass), and 96% of mass when the last action input is a2, i.e. the rare transition a2->S1. Observed inputs only. Dev: P 0.69, R 0.92, F1 0.79, mass recall 0.96. It does not fire on S2 or (almost ever) on common a1->S1 (3.9% of mass, weak). Precision is incomplete: about 30% of a2->S1 steps stay silent, and those are concentrated late in the episode (rate drops sharply after ep_trial ~60; adding ep_trial<60 gives P 0.92 but R 0.72, F1 0.81, which I did not record because it is a time-in-episode gate, not task semantics). Magnitude is larger on the core trial and on repeated rare a2->S1 transitions after an unrewarded D1 (top windows are runs of a2->S1R with r0), but restricting to prev_reward==0 loses most recall. Other conditions tried (choice<-4, good==2, value<7.6) did not help.
